Admissions/Class 11

Class 11 admissions

Discuss Science, Commerce and Arts with the school office. Check the subject combinations, eligibility and costs before choosing your stream.

Ask about Class 11 on WhatsAppCall the office

Choosing your subjects

Which streams can we consider?

Speak with the office about Science, Commerce and Arts. Check which subjects can be taken together and whether those combinations are available.

Which documents will we need?

Ask for the current eligibility and document checklist after Class 10. Keep marksheets and identity documents for the process the office explains to you.

How do we compare subject choices?

Write down the subjects you enjoy and any options you want to keep open. Ask the office about subject combinations, the timetable and fees before you decide.

What happens in the chat?

When you send the draft, the school receives your message from your WhatsApp number. Please leave out your child’s name, marks and documents.

The office can confirm fees, availability and a time to visit.

  1. Give permission for a call

    The chat asks a parent or guardian aged 18 or over whether the office may call this number. You can agree or decline.

  2. Check the class

    Check the class shown, or enter one if you started a general enquiry. You can change the class before confirming.

  3. Send the enquiry

    When the details are right, choose “Send enquiry” to request a call from the office.

What are the current fees?

Fees depend on the class. Ask the office for tuition and any separate costs for books, uniform or transport. You can request a written fee breakdown.
